description: kafka-journal stack: Kafka broker and exporter health, partitions, message and byte rates, replicator lag (teob-rust app gauge and kafka-journal-pekko consumer groups), replicator assignment, broker data disk. Shipped by tools/k3s/kafka.sh; runbook docs/KAFKA-JOURNAL-OPS.md.
title: kafka-journal

panels.title: Broker scrape
panels.description: up{job="kafka"}: Prometheus scrapes the broker's JMX exporter (:9404). DOWN raises KafkaBrokerDown after 5m.

panels.title: Exporter scrape
panels.description: up{job="kafka-exporter"}: the Strimzi kafka-exporter, source of log ends and consumer-group lag. While it is DOWN every replicator lag alert is blind (KafkaExporterDown).

panels.title: Brokers
panels.description: Brokers the exporter sees in the cluster metadata (kafka_brokers).

panels.title: Partitions
panels.description: Partitions hosted by the brokers, internal topics included (kafka_server_replicamanager_partitioncount).

panels.title: Under-replicated partitions
panels.description: kafka_server_replicamanager_underreplicatedpartitions summed over brokers. On a single-node cluster (replication factor 1) this stays 0; offline partitions are in the partition health panel.

panels.title: Unmonitored journal partitions
panels.description: Journal partitions (topic *.journal.*) with events but no replicator position: no teob_replicator_published_next and no committed offset of a *replicator* consumer group. Lag and stall alerts cannot fire for them (KafkaJournalReplicatorUnmonitored). Usually an app whose pods lack the prometheus.io/scrape annotations.

targets.expr: count(max by (topic, partition) (kafka_topic_partition_current_offset{topic=~".+[.]journal[.].+"}) > 0 unless on (topic, partition) max by (topic, partition) (teob_replicator_published_next) unless on (topic, partition) max by (topic, partition) (kafka_consumergroup_lag{consumergroup=~".*replicator.*"} >= 0)) or vector(0)

panels.title: Messages/s per topic
panels.description: Rate of the log end offset per topic (kafka-exporter kafka_topic_partition_current_offset): events appended per second.

panels.title: Broker bytes in/out
panels.description: Strimzi JMX kafka_server_brokertopicmetrics_bytesin_total / bytesout_total. 'all topics' is the broker total (the series without a topic label); the per-topic lines follow the topic variable. Bytes out includes every consumer fetch, replicators included.

panels.title: Replicator lag (teob-rust)
panels.description: Offsets between the journal's log end and the replicator's position, per topic and partition: max(kafka_topic_partition_current_offset) - max over pods(teob_replicator_published_next). The max over pods drops the stale value a pod keeps after losing a partition in a rebalance. KafkaJournalReplicatorLagHigh fires above 10k for 15m; KafkaJournalReplicatorStalled when it stays above 0 with the position unchanged. Empty for apps Prometheus does not scrape (see Unmonitored).

targets.expr: max by (topic, partition) (kafka_topic_partition_current_offset{topic=~"$topic"}) - on (topic, partition) max by (topic, partition) (teob_replicator_published_next{topic=~"$topic"})

panels.title: Consumer-group lag
panels.description: kafka_consumergroup_lag per group, topic and partition, for groups with a committed offset. kafka-journal-pekko replicators commit offsets and show here; teob-rust replicators keep their position in Scylla and never do (see the panel to the left).

panels.title: Replicator partitions assigned / stalled (teob-rust)
panels.description: Per app pod: partitions assigned to it (teob_replicator_assigned), partitions retrying or held (teob_replicator_stalled), partitions whose supervisor ended while still assigned (teob_replicator_ended_while_assigned). These gauges carry only a partition label, no topic, so the topic variable does not apply and an app replicating several topics counts each partition number once.

panels.title: Replicator rebalances / exits (teob-rust)
panels.description: Rebalance events by event (assigned, revoked, lost) from teob_replicator_rebalances_total, and supervisor exits by reason from teob_replicator_exits_total. The exit counter has no series until the first exit.

panels.title: Partition health
panels.description: Broker view (JMX): under-replicated, under min ISR, and offline partitions (controller). Exporter view: under-replicated partitions per topic.

panels.title: Kafka data volume used
panels.description: kubelet_volume_stats used / capacity of the PVCs in the broker's namespace (job kubernetes-nodes; k3s publishes the stats twice). The broker's static local PV reports the whole /data filesystem it shares with Scylla and backups. KafkaJournalDataDiskLow fires under 15% free.

targets.expr: max by (persistentvolumeclaim) (kubelet_volume_stats_used_bytes{job="kubernetes-nodes"} and on (namespace) group by (namespace) (up{job="kafka"})) / max by (persistentvolumeclaim) (kubelet_volume_stats_capacity_bytes{job="kubernetes-nodes"} and on (namespace) group by (namespace) (up{job="kafka"}))
